title: Find Credit Commitment by Debitor
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM

Find Credit Commitment by Debitor

Definition

To find a debtor’s credit commitment information.

Technical Data

Entity Type                                  Service Operation

Release State                               released

Technical Name                          CreditCommitmentQuery_In
Namespace                                    http://sap.com/xi/FICA/Global ri
Application Component                  FI-CA

Web Service Definition (Back End) | CREDITCOMMITMENTQUERY_IN

Category                                     SAP A2A
Direction                                        inbound
Mode                                             synchronous
Idempotency                                  no
Change/Update Behavior                not applicable
P2P Communication Enabled          true

Business Context and Use

This inbound service operation receives requests for updates to a debitor’s current credit commitments.
Related Operations

The Query Credit Commitment by Debitor outbound service operation is sent by the SAP Credit Management process component
to the system Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable is running in to request the information.

Features

The Find Credit Commitment by Debitor operation receives requests made from your credit management system to the system
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA) is running in for the latest information about a debtor’s current credit
commitments. The system uses the debtor’s credit exposure to determine the result.

This operation uses the following message types:

Credit Commitment Query
